answer: The anchor I would price into every new account is Dubbed net maker warrant with net makers attestation: a warrant makers renew after loom audits, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. What makes this stick is that a warrant makers renew after loom audits cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the delta of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the ember for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
